methods: Exact dated borrowing/deposit cash strips and terminal debt clear the carry strategy.
Foreign maturity deposit and domestic repayment give both present old value and terminal short surplus; reciprocal quotation and notional scaling test units.

Arrow-state prices first price the stock and bond, then clear terminal-forward and first-settlement portfolios. Centered covariance is computed directly rather than inferred from the price difference.
Margin balances use cumulative quote changes and cumulative deposits. Each debt is a closed-form sum of separately compounded contributions, independently of the author rolling recurrence.
Actual swap coupon cash is discounted leg by leg; discount differences recover the single-curve telescoping comparison and contractual-rate sensitivity.
Independent deposit repayment/return differences check collateral funding cost, and local basis decomposition checks physical plus short-futures cash.
Seventy-digit Decimal exponentials verify proportional payouts; a completed square proves the numerical hedge optimum and neighboring feasible contract variances.
independence.not_proof_by_testing: Finite numeric cases check implementation and signs. General replication, conditional-expectation, reinvestment, convexity and trading-right arguments were audited analytically in the manuscript.

proof_and_instruction_review.carry: Every asset income/cost is matched by an enforceable dated cash strip. Positive terminal discount is sufficient; equality requires reversal of the entire carry strategy. The separate commodity storage/short-sale qualification prevents an invalid lower-bound claim.
proof_and_instruction_review.fx: Foreign deposit quantity and domestic-per-foreign quotation prove the ratio with both currency units. Different bid/ask and borrowing/lending rights lead to different feasible thresholds, not an automatic unique market price.
proof_and_instruction_review.futures: R_i is measurable at the current node, so it leaves the conditional expectation. Zero-value reset and G_M=S_T support backward induction. The supplied consistent Q and incomplete-market qualification are explicit; no physical probability or unproved uniqueness is assumed.
proof_and_instruction_review.swaps: Rolling a default-free deposit reproduces the matched floating note including final principal. Telescoping uses D0=1 at the reset origin. The general index projection is defined by payment-weighted pricing, not an unrelated forecast; stubs and known fixings are explicitly separated.
proof_and_instruction_review.collateral: The equal-value reusable collateral arrangement is narrowly defined with symmetric execution, no default and no other cash requirement. Its residual H-V(1+c) gives the displayed value; segregated independent margin has its own separately financed ledger.
proof_and_instruction_review.basis_variance: Basis identity requires identical units and matched quantity. Positive benchmark variance gives a strictly convex quadratic; zero variance makes covariance zero and cannot improve this variance. Quantity matching is not claimed to optimize funding or expected cost.
proof_and_instruction_review.prerequisites_and_teaching: Only previously established dated discounting, finite pricing laws, conditional expectation and ordinary calculus are used. All exercises use locally taught methods or named prerequisites; continuous diffusion pricing is not assumed.
proof_and_instruction_review.honest_limits: Fictional contracts and dated historical sources are labeled. No accreditation, current clearing specification, empirical adequacy, universal hedge precision, or independent human certification is claimed.
